history_description: Lists the runs of the workspace (including those of an old relinked path); reduced rounds show as partial.
history_bad_limit_fix: Use an integer greater than zero.
history_unknown_subcommand_fix: Use jgates history, jgates history preserve <runId> or jgates history unpreserve <runId>.
history_missing_run_fix: Pass the id of a run listed by jgates history.
history_run_not_found: Run not found in this workspace: {runId}
history_run_not_found_fix: Check the id with jgates history.
history_preserved: Run {runId} preserved: retention does not delete it.
history_unpreserved: Run {runId} is no longer preserved: retention applies to it again.
history_compare_same: Choose two different runs to compare.
history_run_unfinished: The run {runId} did not finish, so it does not enter a comparison or become a baseline.
history_run_unfinished_fix: Choose a run that has a final result.
storage_workspace_not_found: Workspace not found in the data folder.
storage_workspace_exists: The path {path} still exists (or is the workspace of this session).
storage_workspace_exists_fix: Only a workspace whose path no longer exists can be relinked or have its artifacts deleted.
storage_not_directory_fix: Give the path of a folder that exists.
storage_relink_same: The new path is the same workspace.
storage_relink_same_fix: Give the folder the project was moved to.
storage_relink_cycle: That relink would create a cycle between workspaces.
storage_confirm_required: The confirmation to delete the artifacts is missing.
storage_delete_refused: The artifacts were not deleted because they are outside the data folder or not safe to delete.
